description_en: A chair with a woven seat and back carried by a continuous bent hardwood-and-cane sled frame with no rear feet; the front shows two forward uprights, the side clearly shows the C-shaped support loop, and the rear exposes the hanging seat rail and back bindings. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
